xLogin.title: Sign in to X
xLogin.description: The X browser signs in to X once with your credentials and keeps only the session afterwards. If X asks for a code, enter it here.
xLogin.username: User name or email address at X
xLogin.usernameHint: As when you sign in on x.com.
xLogin.passwordHint: Not stored: it goes encrypted to the X browser, for this sign-in only.

waiting.STARTING: The X browser is signing in to X ...

xLogin.until: The sign-in ends at {time} at the latest.
xLogin.codeRequested: X asks for the code of the two-factor sign-in.
xLogin.codeRejected: X did not accept the code. Please enter a new one.
xLogin.codeHint: From your authenticator app or the text message; a backup code works too.
xLogin.lost: The sign-in has expired. Please start it again.

failure.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: X did not accept the user name or the password.
failure.INVALID_CODE: X did not accept the codes. Please start the sign-in again.
failure.CHALLENGE_REQUIRED: X asks for an additional check. Please sign in once directly on x.com and try again afterwards.
failure.SELECTOR_DRIFT: The interface of X has changed. Signing in is not possible for the time being.
failure.TIMEOUT: The sign-in took too long. Please start it again.
failure.ACCOUNT_MISMATCH: You signed in with another X account than the one to reconnect.
failure.UNAVAILABLE: The X browser is not available right now. Please try again later.
failure.TRANSIENT: The sign-in failed. Please try again later.

connectError.PROVIDER_ERROR: The platform reported an error. Please try again later.
connectError.EXCHANGE_FAILED: The access could not be obtained. Please try again.
